pages.text: Shift-right-click your living companion to recover it. You need one empty main-inventory slot. Identity, owner, current health, stats, growth, dye, equipment, cargo, and applicable plans are retained.
Releasing a recovered item consumes it even in Creative. Blocked placement leaves the item intact. Effects and saved timers pause in item form. Leashes and passengers are detached.

Every recovered release and revival starts in Wait. A miner keeps its layer in the same chunk; a different chunk or dimension creates a new quarry. Select a command to resume. Ordinary world reloads retain saved commands.
